items.question: In which countries are the described ecological study systems located?
goldQueries: SELECT ?paper ?country_label WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c orkgp:P115000 ?s . ?s a orkgc:C65002 ; orkgp:P37524 ?k . ?k rdfs:label ?country_label . }

items.question: Which habitats do the described ecological study systems cover?
goldQueries: SELECT ?paper ?habitat_label WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c orkgp:P115000 ?s . ?s a orkgc:C65002 ; <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/wikidata:P2974> ?h . OPTIONAL { ?h rdfs:label ?hl } BIND(COALESCE(?hl, ?h) AS ?habitat_label) }
